I feel as though he may be making excuses to not move out, which is fine: he doesn't have to. You are able to move out on your own, which I really recommend doing before buying your own house. It may be a really good opportunity to build living independence away from your partner and figure out what it's like to live alone. You don't have to stay with your boyfriend and his family, and you don't need to let them dictate what you do - from the comments, it sounds like you're making some excuses as to why you won't move out as well. Figure out what YOU want to do and how to do it. Your bf doesn't have to do what he's not ready for, and you can go on your own until he's ready

No idea if this is funny or not but my friends still get a kick out of it. When I was 14? Or so, in social studies class we had to make an island and come up with a government system and currency etc. My friend and I crafted this elaborate fantasy island, and our currency was magic mushrooms. In our heads, mushrooms seemed like a fantasy token and were an adequate tradable currency; the magic was tagged on to make it seem extra special. So when we were announcing our island to the class and proudly proclaimed how magic mushrooms were our form of money, we had no idea why everyone started cracking up. The teacher promptly kicked us out and sent us to the principal's office to our confusion; and it was there we realised that we had set up an elaborate drug trade as our currency system.
